name: Alefgard
source:
Alefgard is the apostle of Dark Lord [url=/c98017]Medusa[/url]. Born as a regular Catman monster, he became an apostle and vowed servitude upon drinking Medusa's blood. Surprisingly, he's only 79 years old so he hasn't been Medusa's servant for too long.

He's absolutely devoted to her and works as her butler in her castle. He possesses legendary skill as a butler. He acts as her housekeeper, finance manager, social event planner and also manages Medusa's whole schedule. He also prepares her meals, keeps her informed of everything she needs to know and arranges women for her so she doesn't get bored. He's incredibly competent and efficient, and dutifully does his job with passion and love for her master. Despite this, he's not nearly as relaxed or laid back as Medusa, and gets easily distressed and anxious if things are not done perfectly and in time. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Alefgard]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
